meanings.note: попасть в аварию = to be in a crash

examples.text: У общества слепых произошла страшная авария!
examples.trans: A terrible crash happened at the Society for the Blind!
There was a big accident on the road.

meanings.note: the present tense is normally left out: я мэр = I am the mayor
present есть; у меня есть = I have

examples.trans: You will be asking for forgiveness.
I grew up in a communal flat.

врезаться.gloss: to crash into, to slam into

meanings.en: to crash into, to slam into (+ в + acc.)

examples.text: На огромной скорости машина врезалась в здание!
examples.trans: At huge speed the car crashed into the building!

examples.text: Пьяный за рулём врезался в общество слепых!
examples.trans: Drunk at the wheel, he crashed into the Society for the Blind!

meanings.note: at the start of a sentence

examples.trans: Don't make a fool out of me.

examples.text: На огромной скорости машина врезалась в здание!
examples.trans: At huge speed the car crashed into the building!
This is an old, beautiful building.
I was born and grew up here.

meanings.note: colloquial: Это кошмар! = That's awful / a nightmare!

examples.trans: That's a nightmare, I don't argue.

meanings.note: взять кредит = to take out a loan

examples.text: Он взял большой кредит в банке.
examples.trans: He took out a large loan at the bank.
Which car did you come in?

He is running for a second term.

meanings.en: must, need to, it is necessary

examples.trans: We need to do even more.

начаться.gloss: to begin, to start, to break out

meanings.en: to begin, to start, to break out (intransitive)

examples.trans: The film started at seven sharp.

meanings.note: goes right before the word it negates
plural, also the TV news programme
hesitation, at the start of a sentence

examples.trans: They also called from the Society of the Blind.

meanings.note: used on its own: он пьёт = he drinks
начался пожар = a fire broke out

examples.trans: The firefighters quickly put out the fire.
Fire engines and police are everywhere!

examples.text: На столе стоял полный стакан воды.
examples.trans: A full glass of water stood on the table.
Three and a half per mille?

meanings.note: usually 3rd person: что произошло? = what happened?

examples.text: Я не знаю, как это произошло.
examples.trans: I don't know how it happened.

meanings.en: per mille, parts per thousand (unit of blood alcohol concentration)

examples.trans: Three and a half per mille?
They found two per mille in the blood.

meanings.note: работать + instrumental = to work as: работать мэром
+ instrumental; со before some consonant clusters: со всеми
на огромной скорости = at huge speed

examples.text: На огромной скорости машина врезалась в здание!
examples.trans: At huge speed the car crashed into the building!
He was driving at high speed.

meanings.note: used as a noun: общество слепых = Society of the Blind

examples.trans: The Society of the Blind is waiting for us.

meanings.en: other forms: тебя (gen/acc), тебе (dat), тобой (instr), тебе (prep)
fizzy wine, sparkling drink; soda pop

examples.trans: What was I drinking? Fizzy wine!
A cold bottle of fizzy wine stood on the table.

meanings.note: points at something: это моё = that's mine
